_meta.purpose: Transformer nameplate, thermal parameters, feeder impedance and power factors.

source_voltage_pu.source: PRD v2.0 section 7 (HV source at 1.0 p.u., fixed tap)

impedance_voltage_pct.assumption: assumption: typical short-circuit impedance of a 250 kVA distribution transformer; verify against nameplate

no_load_loss_w.assumption: assumption: typical no-load loss; chosen so load_loss_w / no_load_loss_w equals loss_ratio = 5.0 used by the thermal model; verify against nameplate

load_loss_w.assumption: assumption: typical load loss at rated current for a 250 kVA unit; verify against nameplate

rated_top_oil_rise_c.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

rated_hotspot_rise_over_top_oil_c.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

loss_ratio.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

oil_exponent.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

winding_exponent.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

oil_time_constant_min.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

winding_time_constant_min.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

feeder_resistance_pu.unit: p.u. on a 250 kVA, 415 V base
feeder_resistance_pu.assumption: assumption: roughly 100 m of 185 mm2 aluminium four-core LV cable, typical per-km values; replace with real feeder data

feeder_reactance_pu.unit: p.u. on a 250 kVA, 415 V base
feeder_reactance_pu.assumption: assumption: roughly 100 m of 185 mm2 aluminium four-core LV cable, typical per-km values; replace with real feeder data

power_factor_base.assumption: Fixed design choice, not a measured value.

power_factor_ev.assumption: Fixed design choice, not a measured value.

power_factor_pv.assumption: Fixed design choice, not a measured value.

reference_ambient_c.assumption: assumption: typical value for a 65 C-rise ONAN distribution transformer (80 C hot-spot rise plus 30 C ambient = 110 C reference); not from a specific nameplate; verify against nameplate or standard before real-world use

powerflow_tolerance_pu.assumption: assumption: numerical solver setting for the complex voltage convergence tolerance

powerflow_max_iterations.assumption: assumption: numerical solver setting limiting fixed-point iterations
